name: Network and Infrastructure
description: External and internal network penetration testing coverage.

items.guidance: External data via DNS lookups, ARIN/RIPE records, and public Shodan/Censys data.
ICMP, ARP, and TCP/UDP ping sweeps to map the perimeter or internal layout.
Full TCP and UDP scans over active hosts to locate open entry points.
Banner grabbing and TCP/IP stack analysis for exact versions and OS.
Vulnerability scans (Nessus/OpenVAS) to baseline known CVEs.
Check for out-of-the-box configs, default passwords, and legacy service accounts.
Audit for insecure unencrypted traffic (Telnet, FTP, HTTP, SNMPv1/v2).
Identify outdated TLS (SSLv3, TLS 1.0/1.1) and weak cipher suites.
Correlate discovered versions with weaponized public exploits.
Safely test common passwords against SSH, RDP, or SMB.
Audit compromised hosts for misconfigured services, unquoted paths, kernel gaps.
Use footholds to proxy tools into isolated subnets.
Test firewall/DLP egress controls with dummy data.
Audit corporate Wi-Fi security (WPA2/WPA3 Personal vs Enterprise).
Inspect for unauthorized access points or SSID-mimicking devices.
